title: Harden verification, responsive behavior, a11y, and security regressions
objective: Add cross-page tests and verification hardening for responsive density, accessibility basics, reduced motion, stale-state copy, destructive-action safeguards, and secret leakage across the completed operator console.

must_not_touch: package.json unless a test script from TASK-001 is missing
src/app/** unless a cross-page route bug blocks all tests
src/components/** unless a shared accessibility bug blocks all tests
src/features/** except minimal fixes directly required by failing verification

actions: Create Playwright config that starts the Vite dev server and runs Chromium tests at 375x812, 768x1024, and 1280x900 viewports.
Add e2e smoke coverage for /projects, /projects/:projectId, /deployments/:deploymentId, /projects/:projectId/release/:channel, and /projects/:projectId/rollback/:channel.
Add responsive assertions that tables, lineage chains, log panels, and sticky action bars do not create viewport-level horizontal body overflow or overlap primary actions.
Add release safeguard e2e coverage proving promote and rollback controls are disabled until safety checks pass and audit reasons are present.
Add no-secret-leakage e2e coverage that scans rendered text for fixture canary secrets, raw provider payload markers, and unredacted token patterns.
Add Vitest smoke tests that render every route with fixture scenarios for loading, error, empty, stale, partial route failure, and route drift.
Add lightweight accessibility helpers for labels, focus visibility, icon-button names, non-color status text, and heading structure.
Verify reduced-motion CSS exists and that no page relies on animation to reveal critical state.

files.purpose: destructive action disabled-state and audit checks
shared test assertions for labels, focus, heading structure, and status text

new_tests: Every target route renders inside AppShell at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.
No target route causes document.body.scrollWidth to exceed viewport width except inside intentional table or lineage scroll containers.
Promote and rollback buttons remain disabled without passing safety checks and audit reason.
Rendered DOM for all target routes contains no secret canary, raw webhook payload, raw manifest secret marker, or route config secret marker.
Reduced-motion media query exists in src/styles/tokens.css and computed critical state remains visible without animation.

criteria: playwright.config.ts exists and defines projects or test use settings for 375x812, 768x1024, and 1280x900 viewports.
tests/e2e/operator-console.spec.ts visits all five target routes.
tests/e2e/no-secret-leakage.spec.ts scans rendered DOM text for the fixture canary values defined by src/lib/fixtures/siteflow.fixtures.ts.
tests/e2e/release-safeguards.spec.ts verifies promote and rollback actions are disabled before safety requirements and audit reason are satisfied.
npm test -- --run, npm run build, and npm run test:e2e pass.

risks: Playwright may need browser installation on a fresh machine; document or run npx playwright install if required by the environment.
Responsive tests can be flaky if they rely on screenshots only; prefer DOM layout metrics and targeted assertions.
If this task finds shared bugs, fixes must stay narrowly scoped and avoid broad rewrites of feature work.

execution.findings: Added Playwright/Vitest hardening for five operator routes, responsive overflow, release safeguards, no-secret scans, and a11y helpers. Installed missing Chromium. Fixed default fixture docs-portal aliasing and deployment lineage redaction fallback to keep status text accessible.
execution.tests_passed: npm test -- --run passed: 10 files/56 tests. npm run build passed. npm run test:e2e passed: 51 tests across 375x812, 768x1024, 1280x900.
